newsitem.title: USA: Rocker Ozzy Osbourne forms record label.
newsitem.headline: Rocker Ozzy Osbourne forms record label.

text.p: Ozzy Osbourne, the hard-living veteran of heavy metal music, said on Thursday he has formed a record label which will serve as an antidote to the corporate nature of the music business.
Ozz Records will be a "small, intimate, artist-oriented label" with offices in London and Los Angeles, he said in a statement. "We will be a self-contained company answering to no one."

Osbourne, who records for Sony Corp's Epic Records label, is in talks with "a major record company" for distribution. He will serve as president and chief executive officer of Ozz. His spokesman did not have details about staffing, funding or the musical genres the label would target.

Osbourne, whose real first name is John, has been on a concert tour for the past year to promote his latest album, "Ozzmosis." He found fame more than 25 years ago as the frontman for English heavy metal band Black Sabbath, whose hits included "Paranoid" and "Iron Man."
He was kicked out of the band in the mid-1970s and went on to greater fame as a solo artist.
Among his outrageous acts was biting the head off a bat that was thrown on-stage. He had to undergo a series of painful rabies shots afterward.
